# Cross-Cultural Mission

> Cross-Cultural Mission (CCM) is a church-planting operations platform that surfaces church planter pastors, phases, areas, ministry reports, and prayer requests in one live dashboard.

CCM helps mission coordinators and supporters see where church planters are serving, what stage each field is in, and how to pray for and support them.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/): Live snapshot of missionaries, phases, areas, prayer requests, and reports.
- [Missionary Directory](/missionaries): Browse every church planter pastor by phase, area, and ministry focus.
- [Mission Map](/map): Geographic view of every field and planting area.
- [Phases & Areas](/phases): Organizational structure — phases, areas, and coordinators.
- [Prayer Center](/prayer): Current prayer requests from the field.
- [Prayer Mode](/pray): Guided prayer walk through each missionary.
- [Ministry Reports](/reports): Latest field reports from every missionary.
- [Support Center](/support): Monthly support needs and special projects.
- [Document Library](/documents): Training materials, newsletters, and mission policies.
- [AI Assistant](/assistant): Ask questions grounded in the platform's data.

## Optional

- [Annual Analytics](/analytics): Aggregate ministry analytics.
- [AI Summaries](/summaries): AI-generated report summaries.
